__tissy13__: Konrad Tissy came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Konrad Tissy heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. After the loss of Grey Mill, Konrad Tissy helped stack spare sandbags at U-F18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Konrad Tissy held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Konrad Tissy. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
angrypenguin1000: Viktor Angrypenguin arrived at R-C3 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Viktor Angrypenguin heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Viktor Angrypenguin went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. The clerk counted the names twice. Viktor Angrypenguin is number 781 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor Angrypenguin stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Viktor Angrypenguin counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Viktor Angrypenguin waited for the password before answering.
brad.rodrigues.12: The old hands of P-F6 have been here since Day 1. Emil Rodrigues has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Emil Rodrigues washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Emil Rodrigues wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Emil Rodrigues was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers.
Fog so thick that Emil Rodrigues could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
darian_d_16: Day 9: Silas "Mole" Darian reached S-R10 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Silas "Mole" Darian listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Silas "Mole" Darian wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Silas "Mole" Darian could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Silas "Mole" Darian found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Silas "Mole" Darian saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-R10 and fired once. Quentin "Button" Mail was gravely wounded.
dorio_dorno: Leopold Dorno left a wife and a daughter he has never met behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a frozen apple. The men noticed at once that he laughs at exactly the wrong moments.

Leopold Dorno came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Leopold Dorno watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Asked what he will do after the war, Leopold Dorno said: 'Be a printer's apprentice in Coldwater. And never complain about anything, ever again.' Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Leopold Dorno watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Machine-gun fire swept Q-F3. Leopold Dorno took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67).
Leopold Dorno spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
epgmaker: Nobody saw Edmund Epgmaker arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in V-F21, and a quiet rifleman under it.
esteban.volta: The new sniper gave his name as Felix Volta. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Felix Volta traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Felix Volta did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Dawn watch. Felix Volta put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Henrik Barringarms, gravely wounded. Felix Volta saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at Q-F2 and fired once. Viktor "Owl" Tawt was gravely wounded.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Edmund Keithforbes, gravely wounded. Felix Volta cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
gefocheh2050: Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-C15 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh is number 968. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Dietrich Jib was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
hjerter_knekt: Emil "Whistle" Knekt arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lock of hair in a matchbox and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Emil "Whistle" Knekt could not stop listening to it. Grey Mill is lost. Emil "Whistle" Knekt heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Emil "Whistle" Knekt was hit through the chest at U-F4. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana of the Hegemony (@rsaldana5897). Emil "Whistle" Knekt stood up to fix a loose sandbag at U-F4. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana of the Hegemony (@rsaldana5897).
Zeno Knekt had heard about Emil "Whistle" Knekt's courage. At U-F4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A new trench junction cost Zeno Knekt ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
kowalien: Severin Kowalien came up on Day 8 carrying news from Ashford Vale. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Severin Kowalien got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Severin Kowalien came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. A bullet went through Severin Kowalien's upper arm at S-S15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Walter Pst of the Concord (@pst13606). Severin Kowalien looked over the parapet at S-S15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Walter Pst of the Concord (@pst13606).
Tobias Kowalien asked about Severin Kowalien on arriving at S-S15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

A crow sat on the parapet above Tobias Kowalien all afternoon. The men say it chose him. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias Kowalien is number 553 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Tobias Kowalien helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A bullet went through Tobias Kowalien's sleeve at S-S15 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Norbert "Mud" Leothebeo of the Concord (@leothebeo8).
The wound on Tobias Kowalien's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
kwintenlulay_: Yann Kwintenlulay joined the replacements on Day 5. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. The transfer made Yann Kwintenlulay a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Yann Kwintenlulay cut Gideon "Whistle" Vylet's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close. After the loss of Hill 304, Yann Kwintenlulay helped stack spare sandbags at R-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Yann Kwintenlulay measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close.

Someone asked Yann Kwintenlulay to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close.

Yann Kwintenlulay counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close.
A recruit asked Yann Kwintenlulay how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-S9. Yann Kwintenlulay has learned to walk bent double.

Yann Kwintenlulay had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. Orders assigned Yann Kwintenlulay to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Yann Kwintenlulay answered to number 366. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Yann Kwintenlulay watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Yann Kwintenlulay checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
A stretcher party needed the passage. Yann Kwintenlulay backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed.
moitpan: Day 9. The corporal put Tobias "Smokes" Moitpan beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Tobias "Smokes" Moitpan watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Tobias "Smokes" Moitpan was found at the bottom of the trench at T-F18, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Casimir Lordfulgrim of the Hegemony (@lordfulgrim). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Tobias "Smokes" Moitpan fell at T-F18 and never moved again. Shot by Casimir Lordfulgrim of the Hegemony (@lordfulgrim).

A letter came with Matthias "Bones" Moitpan: "I am Tobias "Smokes" Moitpan's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F18 with the rations. Matthias "Bones" Moitpan ate while listening to the revised orders.

Matthias "Bones" Moitpan was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F18. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Otto "Smokes" Thanbrown of the Hegemony (@e_thanbrown).
Matthias "Bones" Moitpan no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
moregano_1: Day 9: Nils "Ghost" Moregano reached R-R4 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Nils "Ghost" Moregano was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R4. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Rafael Gundam of the Hegemony (@zer0_gundam). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Nils "Ghost" Moregano stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The wound on Nils "Ghost" Moregano's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Nils "Ghost" Moregano got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 931. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-R4 with the rations. Nils "Ghost" Moregano ate while listening to the revised orders.
Nils "Ghost" Moregano woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep.

Nils "Ghost" Moregano was hit in the forearm at R-R4. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Otto Tyner of the Hegemony (@tyner_1776).
pavla.9_: Karel Pavla found a place in R-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Volunteer number 68. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Karel Pavla's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Orders came through: Karel Pavla is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a tin whistle.
A bullet clipped Karel Pavla's helmet at R-F10 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Karel Pavla is whole again, or near enough for the line. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Karel Pavla let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Karel Pavla and Albin "Tin" Shoes compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

Karel Pavla pulled Oskar Eddie out of a flooded shell hole at the Sunken Road. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Pavla went out with the wiring party at R-F10. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F10. Karel Pavla has learned to walk bent double.

Karel Pavla fired at a movement across the wire at R-F10. The man went down: Bram Ahmadhcj, badly wounded. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet went through Karel Pavla's sleeve at R-F10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88). A clear shot from R-F10. Karel Pavla gravely wounded Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso and slid back down below the parapet.

The medic cut the last bandage off Karel Pavla's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-F10 the same hour. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Pavla had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Pavel "Crow" Hayden was badly wounded. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Pavla went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Hugo Xiii put up a fight, but not for long. (@masis_xiii) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Karel Pavla hit Rafael Jacob with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@miguell.jacob) Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Karel Pavla only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F10, then nothing but pain. Raider: Konrad Dorf of the Hegemony (@hunter_dorf0629). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Karel Pavla stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

Back on the fire step at R-F10. Karel Pavla says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Karel Pavla read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

There is a sniper across the way the men call the Widow. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Widow hit all three. Karel Pavla watched where the shots came from. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Pavla fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Edmund Ahmadhcj was badly wounded. Karel Pavla ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.
prestonfeagins: "You're late," said the corporal when Nils "Rabbit" Prestonfeagi arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Nils "Rabbit" Prestonfeagi laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Nils "Rabbit" Prestonfeagi read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Nils "Rabbit" Prestonfeagi pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Nils "Rabbit" Prestonfeagi took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
robboyd03: Teodor Robboyd took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached V-F16 with the rations. Teodor Robboyd ate while listening to the revised orders.
A flare lit the Drowned Farm like noon. Teodor Robboyd counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Teodor Robboyd. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
seal.ingfan: Jakub "Brick" Ingfan arrived on Day 3 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

A clear shot from R-F19. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan grazed Felix Landon and slid back down below the parapet. The transfer made Jakub "Brick" Ingfan a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

The dugout roof dripped into Jakub "Brick" Ingfan's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub "Brick" Ingfan found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Jakub "Brick" Ingfan during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A sniper's bullet hit Jakub "Brick" Ingfan at R-F19. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss of the Concord (@eddholmesss). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Jakub "Brick" Ingfan was carried in at last. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.
The medics would not give up on Jakub "Brick" Ingfan. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F19 today.

Across from R-F19, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan saw it. Teodor Deanc was grazed. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub "Brick" Ingfan did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Jakub "Brick" Ingfan fired back. Felix Landon was grazed. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub "Brick" Ingfan jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Jonas Utku. The Concord medics will be busy. (@mustafa1utku) Jakub "Brick" Ingfan joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Jakub "Brick" Ingfan could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.

The stores supplied Jakub "Brick" Ingfan with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language. The clerk counted the names twice. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan is number 221 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Jakub "Brick" Ingfan fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Florian "Lucky" Nistico was grazed. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-F19. Teodor Anderson was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Jakub "Brick" Ingfan finished the shelter. The crew tested every movement of the gun and discovered that the roof needed moving back a hand's width.
senior_sucio: Day 10. The corporal put Dorian Sucio beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

The sergeant at P-F11 called out a range and a spot. Dorian Sucio was the only one who hit it. Lucien "Hollow" Luhring was grazed. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F11. Dorian Sucio has learned to walk bent double.
Dorian Sucio (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob (Hegemony) at the Bone Quarry. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Dorian Sucio had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Viktor Jcksn crossed it, Dorian Sucio fired. Viktor Jcksn was badly wounded.
superfeisty7: On the way to R-F9, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
One of the first hundred, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty and Isidor Glc made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands.

A section of parapet collapsed near Rafael "Button" Superfeisty. The repairs began as soon as the dust settled, with one man watching while the others worked. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty fixed the strap on Pavel Mvuisak's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac held the mirror while Rafael "Button" Superfeisty shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. After the loss of Hill 304, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty helped stack spare sandbags at R-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

A sniper's bullet hit Rafael "Button" Superfeisty at R-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud). A clear shot from R-F9. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty grazed Pavel "Crow" Hayden and slid back down below the parapet. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty was killed outright at R-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud).

Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty asked about Rafael "Button" Superfeisty on arriving at R-F9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.

A bullet went into Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty's chest just under the heart at R-F9. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi). Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F9 and fired once. Jakub You was grazed. Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty was hit at R-F9 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi).

The papers connected Wendel Superfeisty to Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty. The men took longer to learn Wendel Superfeisty's own habits, but they made the effort. Wendel Superfeisty was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Wendel Superfeisty was hit in the forearm at R-F9. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud).

Wendel Superfeisty no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Blackwater Canal is lost. Wendel Superfeisty heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Wendel Superfeisty fired at a movement across the wire at R-F9. The man went down: Bastian Lover, grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Wendel Superfeisty looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Wendel Superfeisty smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Arno "Shadow" Meloche came out for a cup and was grazed. Wendel Superfeisty was hit in the hip at R-F9. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h).
Wendel Superfeisty lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
thomas.stnmz: Tobias Stnmz came up on Day 10 carrying news from Wyvern Cross. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

New laces made Tobias Stnmz's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias Stnmz. Tobias Stnmz read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Tobias Stnmz wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Tobias Stnmz found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias Stnmz. Tobias Stnmz read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Tobias Stnmz watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias Stnmz. Tobias Stnmz read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
